name: tile-select
prompt: A short soft pop of a finger tapping a wooden number tile on a notebook page, gentle high knock, very brief, no reverb tail.

name: tile-deselect
prompt: A quiet dull tap of a wooden tile settling back down onto paper, lower and softer than a pick-up tap, very short.

name: pair-clear
prompt: Two wooden number tiles clack together and slide off a paper page with a bright satisfying chalk scratch, cheerful small impact with a short paper swish.

name: chain-clear
prompt: A rapid cascade of several wooden tiles clacking one after another off a notebook page, ascending rhythmic clicks with a paper flutter, energetic combo payoff.

name: row-collapse
prompt: A whole row of paper tiles whisking upward off a desk, fast airy paper whoosh ending in a soft flutter, like tearing a finished page free.

name: rows-added
prompt: A fresh strip of paper being unrolled and pressed onto a notebook with a soft sticky tape stretch and gentle page slap.

name: invalid-pair
prompt: A muted wooden block bonk against a desk, dull and apologetic, single short low thud with a tiny pencil rattle, clearly a negative buzzer without harshness.

name: round-win
prompt: A small celebratory desk bell ding followed by a handful of wooden tiles happily clattering and a page flipping shut, warm triumphant miniature fanfare of real objects.

name: round-lose
prompt: A pencil dropping onto a desk and rolling to a stop with a soft descending clatter, tired and final but gentle.

name: hint-reveal
prompt: A highlighter marker swiping once across paper with a bright squeaky stroke, short and sparkly, drawing attention.

name: undo-move
prompt: An eraser rubbing a pencil mark off paper in one quick backwards scrub, soft grainy friction, short reversal feel.

name: ui-click
prompt: A crisp ballpoint pen click, single short mechanical snap, clean and dry, minimal tail.
